name: content-workspace
purpose: Workspace-scoped social and website publishing for AI agents.

tools.name: get_workspace_context
tools.description: Return the workspace, plan, role and scopes bound to this credential. Call first.

tools.name: get_content_strategy
tools.description: Return the latest and approved content strategy. Treat only status=approved as authority.

tools.name: preview_schedule
tools.description: Preview the next slot for one channel. Never creates, moves or publishes content.

tools.name: create_publication_draft
tools.description: Create an editable social draft. Never schedules or publishes. Requires an idempotency key.

tools.name: prepare_publication_action
tools.description: Prepare one schedule, publish or cancel action. Returns preview and confirmation_phrase. Executes nothing.

tools.name: confirm_publication_action
tools.description: Execute one still-fresh prepared action after explicit approval or approved_strategy policy.

skills.name: publish-content
skills.description: Draft and prepare a social post in the workspace. Use when the user wants a post saved or queued. Always preview before confirm.
